title: Forgotten Crypt
summary: The first dungeon, a two-floor burial complex under forests and plains. The Bone Knight, the Crypt Warden and the gear made from Warden's Sigils.

s.x: The Forgotten Crypt is the first dungeon most players clear. It is a sealed two-floor burial complex under forests, plains and meadows, full of skeletons, zombies and the dead of a forgotten order. It is common, easy to find and forgiving, and its boss, the
, drops the Warden's Sigils you need for the first set of dungeon gear. It is a good place to learn how

s.x: Two rooms hide their loot behind an iron-bar gate and a row of levers. The sign says what to do. "Wake" means pull the lever on.
Four levers. "Wake the first and the last. Let the middle two sleep." Pull lever 1 and lever 4 on, and leave 2 and 3 off. It holds a secret cache.

Five levers. "Three kings sat, two slept below. Wake the first, the third, the last." Pull levers 1, 3 and 5 on, and leave 2 and 4 off. It holds a rare chest, and a pack with a Crypt Captain guards it.

s.x: (Undead Hunter, all four pieces): +25% damage to zombies and skeletons, your hits heal 2% of the damage they deal, +25 Strength and +20 Defense. The Cryptbreaker does +30% to zombies, skeletons and the Grave Tyrant and Bone Marshal slayer bosses.

Clear every pack on both floors and find the secrets before you fight the Warden. Each three packs, each secret and each champion adds a bonus roll to the Reward Chest. The Crypt is short enough to do in one sitting.
Bring a shield or sprint through the corridors with arrow slits.
Kill Elites for the key early so the vault is ready.
A bow or crossbow works well against the Warden's summons. Keep melee for the Warden itself.
